auditMethod: candidate JSON versus fixed Gold JSON under benchmarks/paper-import/SCORING-PROTOCOL.md; semantic equivalence reviewed by Codex

reasons: The candidate has excellent object coverage and materially recovers the triple module, boundary algebra, evaluation bridge, general gluing theorem, and all handle formulas.

The B0 inventory recovers semantic equivalents of the Gold evaluation isomorphism and Khovanov tangle functor, but still omits the MWW skein-lasagna foundation and the Ren-Willis general gluing-surjection boundary.

The B0 is substantially over-inclusive: several historical special-case 1-, 2-, 3-, and 4-handle results cited for context are classified as active external dependencies even though they are not direct premises of the paper's new general formulas.
The selected main target is a derived gluing-summary Claim rather than the stronger newly proved general gluing theorem from which the summary and handle applications follow.
The final graph is acyclic and closed, but nine deterministic structural removals were needed on the first assembly and eight on the reviewed assembly.
